name: Watercress
siboNotes: Watercress is naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated by most SIBO patients. Its mild peppery flavor makes it easy to digest.
preparationTips: Rinse thoroughly under cold water to remove any grit or sand
Remove thick stems for better digestibility
Use fresh within 2-3 days as it wilts quickly
Add to salads raw or lightly sauté for a milder flavor
nutritionalHighlights: Excellent source of vitamin K for bone health
High in vitamin C for immune support
Good source of calcium and iron
